decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges, as the terms note for these books sets: "concubina" names a wife of lower rank (m1); Readable explains the word the first time in a chapter, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וַיָּ֛מָת גִּדְע֥וֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָ֖שׁ בְּשֵׂיבָ֣ה טוֹבָ֑ה וַיִּקָּבֵ֗ר בְּקֶ֨בֶר֙ יוֹאָ֣שׁ אָבִ֔יו בְּעָפְרָ֖ה אֲבִ֥י הָֽעֶזְרִֽי׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And died Gideon son of Joash in old age good, and he was buried in [the] tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of [the] Abiezrite[s].

en.L: And Gideon son of Joash died at a good old age, and he was buried in the tomb of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
en.B: Gideon son of Joash died at a good old age and was buried in his father Joash's tomb at Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
en.R: Gideon son of Joash lived a long, full life and died very old. He was buried in his father Joash's tomb in Ophrah, the town of the Abiezrite clan.

sw.L: Naye Gideoni mwana wa Yoashi akafa katika uzee mwema, akazikwa katika kaburi la Yoashi baba yake, huko Ofra ya Waabiezeri.
sw.B: Gideoni mwana wa Yoashi alikufa akiwa na umri mkubwa, akazikwa katika kaburi la Yoashi baba yake huko Ofra ya Waabiezeri.
sw.R: Gideoni mwana wa Yoashi aliishi maisha marefu na mema, akafa akiwa mzee sana. Alizikwa katika kaburi la baba yake Yoashi huko Ofra, mji wa ukoo wa Abiezeri.

es.L: Y murió Gedeón hijo de Joás en buena vejez, y fue sepultado en el sepulcro de Joás su padre, en Ofra de los abiezeritas.
es.B: Gedeón hijo de Joás murió en buena vejez y fue sepultado en el sepulcro de su padre Joás, en Ofra de los abiezeritas.
es.R: Gedeón hijo de Joás vivió una vida larga y plena y murió muy anciano. Fue sepultado en el sepulcro de su padre Joás, en Ofra, la ciudad del clan de los abiezeritas.

decisions.choice: a good old age: a long life ending in peace
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of Abraham and David (Genesis 15:15; 25:8; 1 Chronicles 29:28): a full life and a peaceful death.

decisions.choice: Ophrah of the Abiezrites: Gideon's home town
decisions.reason: The clan name marks this Ophrah off from the Ophrah in Benjamin (Joshua 18:23). Gideon's family lived there (6:11, 24).

decisions.choice: lived a long, full life and died very old
decisions.reason: Readable says in plain words what "a good old age" means.

records.literal_gloss: And it was, as had died Gideon, and turned back [the] sons of Israel and prostituted themselves after the Baals, and they set for themselves Baal-berith as god.

en.L: And it was, when Gideon had died, that the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel turned back and prostituted themselves after the Baals, and they set up Baal-berith for themselves as god.
en.B: As soon as Gideon was dead, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} turned away again and prostituted themselves to the Baals. They made Baal-berith their god.
en.R: As soon as Gideon died, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} turned away from God again. They were unfaithful to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and worshiped the Baals, and they made Baal-berith their god.

sw.L: Ikawa Gideoni alipokwisha kufa, wana wa Israeli wakarudi nyuma, wakazini kwa kuwafuata Mabaali, wakajifanyia Baal-berithi kuwa mungu.
sw.B: Mara tu Gideoni alipokufa, Waisraeli waligeuka tena, wakazini kwa kuwafuata Mabaali. Walimfanya Baal-berithi kuwa mungu wao.
sw.R: Mara tu Gideoni alipokufa, Waisraeli walimwacha Mungu tena. Hawakuwa waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, wakawaabudu Mabaali, wakamfanya Baal-berithi kuwa mungu wao.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando murió Gedeón, los hijos de Israel se volvieron y se prostituyeron tras los baales, y pusieron a Baal-berit por su dios.
es.B: En cuanto murió Gedeón, los israelitas volvieron a apartarse y se prostituyeron con los baales. Hicieron a Baal-berit su dios.
es.R: En cuanto murió Gedeón, los israelitas volvieron a apartarse de Dios. Le fueron infieles a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y adoraron a los baales, e hicieron a Baal-berit su dios.

decisions.choice: when the judge died, Israel turned back
decisions.reason: The book's pattern: after each judge died, the people turned away again (2:19).

decisions.choice: Baal-berith: "Baal of the covenant", the god of Shechem
decisions.reason: His temple stood in Shechem, and its silver paid for Abimelech's men (9:4, 46). The name may mean a god who guarded treaties, a bitter name given Israel's covenant with the LORD.

decisions.choice: prostituted themselves: as in verse 27
decisions.reason: Worshiping the Baals is pictured as unfaithfulness in marriage.

decisions.choice: the Baals: the local forms of the god Baal
decisions.reason: Baal was worshiped under many local names and in many shrines, so the plural is used (2:11).

decisions.choice: turned away from God; unfaithful to him
decisions.reason: Readable says from whom they turned and what the picture of prostitution means, as in verse 27.

records.literal_gloss: And not remembered [the] sons of Israel Yahweh their God, who delivered them from [the] hand of all their enemies from all around.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel did not remember {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, who had delivered them from the hand of all their enemies all around.
en.B: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} did not remember {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, who had rescued them from the power of all the enemies around them.
en.R: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} forgot about {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, who had rescued them from all the enemies around them.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Israeli hawakumkumbuka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, aliyewaokoa mkononi mwa adui zao wote pande zote.
sw.B: Waisraeli hawakumkumbuka {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, aliyekuwa amewaokoa kutoka mikononi mwa adui zao wote waliowazunguka.
sw.R: Waisraeli walimsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, aliyekuwa amewaokoa kutoka kwa adui zao wote waliowazunguka.

es.L: Y no se acordaron los hijos de Israel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, que los había librado de la mano de todos sus enemigos de alrededor.
es.B: Los israelitas no se acordaron {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, que los había rescatado del poder de todos los enemigos que los rodeaban.
es.R: Los israelitas se olvidaron {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, que los había rescatado de todos los enemigos que los rodeaban.

decisions.choice: did not remember: did not stay loyal to
decisions.reason: To remember the LORD is to keep him in mind and live by it (Deuteronomy 8:18); not to remember him is to turn from him, which Moses warned against (Deuteronomy 8:11-14).

decisions.choice: the hand of their enemies: their enemies' power
decisions.reason: As in verse 22.

decisions.choice: forgot about
decisions.reason: Readable says "forgot", the plain opposite of "remember".

records.literal_gloss: And not they did loyal love with [the] house of Jerubbaal, Gideon, according to all the good which he had done with Israel.

en.L: And they did not do steadfast love with the house of Jerubbaal, Gideon, according to all the good that he had done with Israel.
en.B: Nor did they show faithful love to the family of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, in return for all the good he had done for Israel.
en.R: They did not show faithful love to the family of Gideon, who was also called Jerubbaal, even though he had done so much good for Israel.

sw.L: Wala hawakuitendea fadhili nyumba ya Yerubaali, Gideoni, kwa kadiri ya mema yote aliyowatendea Israeli.
sw.B: Wala hawakuionyesha fadhili jamaa ya Yerubaali, yaani Gideoni, kwa malipo ya mema yote aliyowatendea Israeli.
sw.R: Hawakuionyesha fadhili jamaa ya Gideoni, aliyeitwa pia Yerubaali, ingawa alikuwa amewatendea Israeli mema mengi.

es.L: Y no hicieron bondad con la casa de Jerobaal, Gedeón, conforme a todo el bien que él había hecho con Israel.
es.B: Tampoco mostraron bondad a la familia de Jerobaal, es decir, Gedeón, en pago por todo el bien que él había hecho a Israel.
es.R: No trataron con bondad a la familia de Gedeón, a quien también llamaban Jerobaal, aunque él había hecho tanto bien a Israel.

decisions.choice: steadfast love: the faithfulness owed in return for kindness
decisions.reason: The word means steady, faithful kindness that keeps a bond (Ruth 1:8; Joshua 2:12). Gideon had done Israel great good, and they owed his family loyalty in return.

decisions.choice: the house of Jerubbaal: Gideon's sons
decisions.reason: The next chapter shows what this failure meant: Shechem backed Abimelech when he killed Gideon's sons, and Jotham charges them with not treating Jerubbaal's house well (9:5, 16-19).

decisions.choice: Jerubbaal, Gideon: the two names side by side
decisions.reason: Both names are given, linking this chapter to the next, which uses "Jerubbaal" (9:1-2).

decisions.choice: steadfast love (L); faithful love (B, R); family
decisions.reason: Literal says "steadfast love" and Balanced and Readable "faithful love", as in 1:24, Exodus 34:6 and Deuteronomy. Balanced and Readable say "family" for "house".
